The first primed declaration uses a global IsFiniteMeasure instance, measurable edistances, and uniform convergence on the complement of a measurable exceptional set.
The second primed declaration combines global finite measure with strong measurability.
All four generalize the usual natural-number real-valued formulation to a Countable Nonempty SemilatticeSup index and a PseudoEMetricSpace codomain.
